issues.line: const packed = (end) => { const a = []; while (p < end) a.push(varint()); if (p !== end) bad(); return a; };
issues.why: False positive: the loop advances the shared cursor p inside varint() (a closure), so p < end changes every iteration. end is bounded by the buffer (endOf) and varint() throws at the end of data, so the loop always terminates.
